name: com.talkjs/talkjs
title: TalkJS
description: Let your AI assistant configure and manage TalkJS chat in your app.

tools.name: create_secret_key
tools.description: Create a new active secret key for the connected test app and return its ID and metadata only. Never returns the secret value. Ask the user to view it in the TalkJS dashboard or manually run `talkjs secret-keys get <id>` in their terminal. Creates a new key on every call; at most 10 keys are allowed. Does not change webhook selection.

tools.name: delete_secret_key
tools.description: Permanently delete an inactive secret key that is not selected for webhooks, from the connected test app. Deactivate it first; select a replacement if it is the current webhook key.

id.description: The full 12-character ID returned by list_secret_keys.

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Check whether this request is connected to a TalkJS test app. No login is required. When disconnected, returns concrete login instructions to show the user for their client.

tools.name: get_secret_key
tools.description: Get a secret key's ID and metadata for the connected test app. Never returns the secret value. To view it, ask the user to open the key in the TalkJS dashboard or manually run `talkjs secret-keys get <id>` in their terminal.

id.description: The full 12-character ID returned by list_secret_keys.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description:
Read basic settings for the connected TalkJS test app. Requires login and settings:read.
If authentication is required, show the user the concrete steps for their client:
Connect your TalkJS account using the steps for your client:
- Codex CLI: type `/mcp login talkjs` in the active Codex session.
- Claude Code: type `/mcp`, select the TalkJS server, and follow the authentication prompts.
- ChatGPT web: use the Connect/Sign in prompt shown for the TalkJS tool. If no prompt appears, open the TalkJS plugin's connection settings and connect your account.
- Claude web: open Customize > Connectors, find TalkJS, and click Connect.
- Cursor: open Customize > MCP, select TalkJS, and follow the sign-in prompt.
- Other MCP clients: open the TalkJS server's connection settings and choose Authenticate, Sign in, or Connect.

`talkjs` in these commands is the configured MCP server name. Substitute the actual name if it was registered differently.
Complete browser authorization, choose the TalkJS project's test app, then retry the requested operation.

Terminal alternatives: run `codex mcp login talkjs` for Codex or `claude mcp login talkjs` for Claude Code.
After terminal login, reconnect the MCP server in the active client if it still reports disconnected; start a new agent session if necessary.

tools.name: list_secret_keys
tools.description: List the connected test app's secret-key IDs, creation times, active status and webhook selection. Returns metadata only.

tools.name: update_secret_key
tools.description: Activate/deactivate a test app secret key or select it for webhooks. Supply active and/or usedForWebhooks as booleans. Select an active replacement before unselecting or deactivating the current webhook key. Returns metadata only.

active.description: Whether the key is valid for authentication.

id.description: The full 12-character ID returned by list_secret_keys.

usedForWebhooks.description: Select an active key for webhook signing, replacing the current selection.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description:
Update the connected TalkJS test app's settings. Supply one or more fields.
Custom fields merge; a null entry deletes that field, and custom: null clears all custom fields.
Requiring authentication needs backend-generated user tokens; making it optional permits impersonation.

authentication.description: Whether users must supply backend-generated authentication tokens.

custom.description: Custom fields to merge. Values are strings or null to delete; null for the whole field clears all custom fields.

defaultLocale.description: Locale, for example en-US or pl; normalized by TalkJS.

name.description: App name; trimmed and must not be empty.
